offering_description.value: Distributes plumbing, HVAC, waterworks, fire protection and industrial products to contractors, builders, municipalities and industrial customers. Sells through a large branch network, delivery, online ordering and fabrication of pipe assemblies.

primary_products.value: plumbing products; HVAC equipment and parts; waterworks products; fire protection products; industrial pipe, valves and fittings

primary_services.value: delivery and logistics; pipe fabrication; supply chain and inventory management; technical training

customer_segment.value: B2B: residential and commercial contractors, plumbers, HVAC installers, builders, industrial firms; B2G: municipalities and water utilities

end_markets.value: residential construction; commercial construction; municipal water infrastructure; industrial; data centers

revenue_model.value: product sales: plumbing, HVAC, waterworks, fire and industrial products sold to contractors and utilities; service fees: delivery, fabrication and other value-added services

value_chain_position.value: distributor: buys from manufacturers and sells to contractors, builders and municipalities; service provider: fabrication and delivery services for contractor and industrial customers

geography_served.value: North America: United States, with nationwide branch coverage and operations in Canada

specialization.value: related lines: plumbing, HVAC, waterworks, fire protection and industrial product lines sold to the same contractor customers

distribution_channels.value: own locations: large network of company branches and distribution centers; direct sales: sales representatives serving contractors and industrial accounts; online: e-commerce ordering for trade customers

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: building codes, product certification, and transport and environmental rules for chemicals and refrigerants

notes: Canadian operations and branch counts are approximate.
